title: TJ NDE 9991
content: The dentist terrifies me. He had given me valium in a prior visit, which did not help. The dentist had been 'experimenting' with what was needed for me to be able to go through procedures. This visit he was using laughing gas. As I was under, I could see my body and everything in the room including the dentist and her assistant. It seemed as if I were floating over my body, the room, and the procedure. I was trying to figure out what was going on. Next, I was standing in a completely dark room. I couldn't tell the walls from the floor or ceiling. Then all of the sudden, it was as if I had a rope tied around my waist while I was gradually being pulled towards a pure light in a dark robe. I was able to reach to my right and could grab a wall, yet I could not see it. As I was being slowly pulled. I kept saying, 'I am not ready' as flashes of my children ran through my mind. I had so much more to do for them to get them ready for this world. I could tell it was not Male or Female. It was the most beautiful thing I had ever seen. As quickly all of that was happening, I felt overwhelmed by anxiety. This experience was abruptly ended when I heard, 'Oh no! He's going to pop!' I immediately sat up and puked. Then, I hopped up, out of the chair and went straight over to hold onto a wall. It took me a few seconds to feel like I was not dying. This experience was all very surreal for me. I haven't told many people this story, but I can tell you that it has changed me forever. It has given me a pleasant, safe feeling knowing that when it is my time to go, there is something safe for my soul. Knowing that there is a grand scheme for everyone and everything is very comforting. I know that sounds a lot like 'God' or whatever we call the being I saw, but I know there is a sense of comfort that has come over my life. I was able to get that second chance. I now feel confident that my children have been raised properly and that my 'job' is complete. This instance in life has changed my perspective knowing there is nothing to fear. Strange but comforting. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 2012 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain While under general anesthesia. Other: I was under general anesthesia. I was out of my body as they gave me too much gas. While under, I could tell the dentist and her helper were extremely concerned with my health. How do you consider the content of your experience? Both pleasant AND distressing Did you feel separated from your body? No. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than norma. I could SEE and FEEL everything that was going on around me. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? In the middle of it Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. It felt like time stood still. Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Please see my previous description of the incident. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. It was like I could hear/see/feel everything all at once. I can't explain how that makes sense, but I was everywhere and nowhere all at the same time. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes It was more like a dark hallway. I couldn't SEE the spots where the walls met the ceiling or floor, but when pulled I grabbed the wall. It was there. Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes I saw a figure of light. This was a form of a person-like body but it was all-light with a dark robe on. I couldn't tell if it was Male or Female. However, I could tell it was the most beautiful thing I have ever seen. That was the feeling I got. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? I felt despair, anxious, nervous, and concerned. I was fearful that my children would be raised without their father figure in their lives. It felt as everything to me. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Select. Evolutionist if anything Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? I do not know if I believe in a higher power. The being I met was not necessarily God as taught to everyone. It was something though. Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? Uncertain During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Uncertain I felt as if I were going to die at that moment. I was going to be taken away to another place. During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes The light was the supreme being. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I knew that it was taking me away from my life on Earth. There was nothing spoken TO ME, I could just tell. During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? No Did you gain information about how to live our lives? Yes There is another place we go when we die. I felt that. Whether it is my energy back into the universe, reincarnation, or heaven/hell, we definately go somewhere else. During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes I can't explain the FEELING that this experience gave me How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was probably real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was probably real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No gmoqr3i_nde
